criteria.text: Fresh/upgrade/idempotent SQLite dispatch-only schema; no backfill or historical fabrication; no served-step table or shared agent_sessions columns
Structured local-only dispatch CRUD/outcome, stable ids/order/pagination, nullable SDK linkage, requested/resolved/final model and predecessor
Existing hard delete and age purge cascade dispatches; real message-repository deletion retains dispatch; late write FK prevents resurrection
Bounded identifier/reason shapes, owned origin/source and outcome enums, closed typed input, and discarded runtime extras without prompt/body columns or mutation on invalid input
Postgres explicitly unavailable across all five repository methods before SQLite prepare; SQLite-only schema ownership and existing bootstrap parity
Engine revert endpoint retains B1 dispatches
criteria.reason: B1 exercises real message-repository deletion, not the engine revert endpoint; exercise only in a separately approved engine integration slice.
B1 defines no HTTP route or served identity; defer API/engine integration to B2/B3.
B1 is explicitly SQLite-local; no live Postgres connection or parity claim.

caveats: Closed DispatchInput shape is not a secret-content filter: identifier-like secrets can fit allowed fields, and runtime boolean fields coerce truthy/falsy values; callers must supply server-owned, sanitized metadata.
No repository owner/authorization check; no route or public API is shipped by B1.
Pagination limit is clamped to 1..200 (default 100) and ordered by SQLite rowid, not created_at/id; non-finite limit behavior is not contracted.
Sandbox startup/restart verified schema and FK metadata on a synthetic fixture, not served/runtime dispatch behavior or a Postgres server.
